'''2012 US Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 8–10 June 2012, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> Xerox Day 1 and Day 2 sheets from the tournament-decklists PDFs are listed below as those scans are transcribed. [[Emil Wallin]] is the published US National Champion.<ref name="winners">https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 8–10 June 2012
* '''Winner:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
